items.title: 32.8 Mausami tabdeeli ka fasalon par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.8, printed pages 236-237 (PDF 239-240).

blocks.text: Mausam ki tabdeeli (climate change) se sab se zyada khatra zaraat (agriculture) ko hai. Climate change ki wajah se temperature, barish (precipitation) aur shadeed mausami waqiat mein tabdeeli seedha kheti par asar dalti hai. Garmi ka dabao (heat stress) paude mein paani ki kami (dehydration) karta hai, jis se aakhir photosynthesis aur saans lene (respiration) ka amal kamzor ho jata hai. Zyada temperature paude ka metabolism tez kar sakta hai, lekin agar garmi had se barh jaye to paude heat stress ka shikaar ho jaate hain aur un ki barhotri aur paidawar kam ho jaati hai. Isi tarah sard mausam bhi kuch fasalon ko nuqsan deta hai; yeh chhote paudon ke liye jaan-leva hai aur poori fasal zaya ho sakti hai.

Aam barish paudon ko sehatmand barhotri ke liye kaafi paani aur nutrients deti hai. Lekin barish ke andaaz badal jayein to kuch ilaqon mein khushk-saali (drought) aur kuch mein selaab (floods) aa sakte hain, aur dono se fasal tabah ho sakti hai. Be-waqt barish aur badal phatna (cloud burst) soil erosion (mitti ka bahna) karte hain aur nutrients se bhari oopar wali mitti (top soil) baha le jaate hain.

Hurricanes (samundari toofan), heatwaves (garmi ki lehrein) aur ole (hailstorms) fasalein aur kheti ka dhancha (infrastructure) tabah kar sakte hain, jis se khuraak ki qillat ho jaati hai. Toofan paude jar se ukhaar dete hain aur shaakhein tor dete hain. Tez hawayein paani ki kami aur khushk-saali la sakti hain. Ole patton, phalon aur tanon ko nuqsan dete hain, tissues toot jaate hain aur photosynthesis kamzor ho jata hai. Shadeed ole poori fasal tabah kar ke saari paidawar khatam kar sakte hain. Zyada UV-index (suraj ki ultraviolet shuaon ki shiddat) aur heatwaves fasal par sakht heat stress dalti hain, paani tezi se urta hai aur patte jal bhi sakte hain.

In tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalne ke liye scientists nayi fasalon ki aisi qismein (varieties) bana rahe hain jo mukhtalif mausam behtar bardasht kar sakein (resilient), maslan khushk-saali bardasht karne wali makai (drought-resistant corn) ya garmi bardasht karne wali gandum (heat-tolerant wheat). Khushk-saali aur selaab bardasht karne wali khoobiyan (traits) bhi banayi gayi hain. Maslan “Sub1 rice” do hafte tak paani mein doobe reh kar bhi zinda reh sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Climate change fasal ki paidawar kam karne ke do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: heat stress aur paani ki kami; badli hui barish se khushk-saali ya selaab; badal phatne se top soil ka bahna; toofan, ole ya heatwaves se tabahi; sardi se chhote paudon ki maut.

items: Garmi, sardi, khushk-saali, selaab, toofan aur ole paidawar ghatate hain.
Heat stress: dehydration, kamzor photosynthesis, kam yield.
Nayi qismein: drought-resistant corn, heat-tolerant wheat, Sub1 rice (do hafte paani mein zinda).
